question: Who among the following became the first Indian to be signed by Elektra Records, a U.S.company in October 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Prateek Kuhad**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Prateek Kuhad** became the first Indian artist to sign with **Elektra Records**, a U.S.-based music label, in October 2020.
 
• Elektra Records is a prominent American record label known for signing globally acclaimed artists such as **Metallica** and **The Doors**.
 
• Kuhad’s signing with Elektra Records highlights his growing international recognition, particularly after his song **"cold/mess"** was featured on former U.S. President Barack Obama’s 2019 list of favorite songs.
 
• This partnership aimed to bring Kuhad’s music to a global audience and expand his reach in the American and international music scenes.
 
• Prateek Kuhad, known for his soulful indie music, is one of the most celebrated contemporary Indian singer-songwriters.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Elektra Records**

 
 
• Founded in 1950 by Jac Holzman, Elektra Records is one of the oldest and most respected record labels in the U.S.
 
• It is now part of the Warner Music Group and continues to work with a diverse range of artists.
 
• The label has been instrumental in shaping modern music, representing genres like rock, folk, and pop.
 
 
 
• **Prateek Kuhad's Achievements**
 
 
• Kuhad is widely recognized for his genre-defining indie-folk music in both English and Hindi.
 
• His track **"cold/mess"** brought him widespread acclaim, including being featured on Barack Obama’s playlist.
 
• He has won multiple awards, including the **MTV Europe Music Award for Best India Act** in 2016.
 
 
 
• **Indie Music in India**
 
 
• The independent music scene in India has grown significantly in the last decade, with artists exploring genres beyond traditional Bollywood music.
 
• Platforms like Spotify, YouTube, and Apple Music have helped indie artists like Kuhad reach global audiences.
 
 
 
• **Barack Obama's Playlist**
 
 
• Obama’s annual playlist often includes a mix of mainstream and indie tracks, giving global recognition to lesser-known artists.
 
• Prateek Kuhad's inclusion in 2019 was a major milestone for Indian indie music.
